source.title: Northern Whig, 20 September 1946, p. 3 ("Rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Contested votes from the Belfast News-Letter results (5 October 1946, p. 3); unopposed returns from the Northern Whig (20 September 1946, p. 3); Groomsport withdrawal from the Belfast News-Letter (21 September 1946, p. 3).

note: Triennial election of the Newtownards Rural District Council, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. Four divisions were contested; Groomsport became unopposed on Thomas Campbell's withdrawal, and fourteen divisions were uncontested. Returned unopposed.
